description: BATCH 2 of the round-4 builder wordings (T01 to T44). Written AFTER the cue families in risk_screen.py were frozen, in styles different from batch 1 and with vocabulary the cues were not built around, then run ONCE with no change in between; 'screen_first_run_class' is that single first run. The misses were fixed afterwards (see the eval report). They are the builder's own wordings and are NOT independent evidence. Each row carries the builder's BLIND answers to the four screen questions, written before the run, with one line of evidence each; 'min_class' is the floor judged from the autonomy matrix and 'max_ok_class' the highest class accepted without calling it an over-raise. No real data.
